phases.name: Image Manipulation
phases.description: Add crop, rotate, and flip functionality — the most expected features in any image tool

subtasks.title: Implement image rotation and flip controls
subtasks.description: Add rotation (90° CW, 90° CCW) and flip (horizontal, vertical) buttons to the editor controls panel. Apply transforms via Canvas API before resize. Update preview dimensions when rotating (swap width/height for 90° rotations).
completion_criteria: Rotate 90° clockwise button works and updates preview
Rotate 90° counter-clockwise button works
Flip horizontal mirrors the image correctly
Flip vertical mirrors the image correctly
Dimensions swap correctly on 90° rotation (width↔height)
Aspect ratio recalculates after rotation
Transforms compose correctly (rotate + flip + resize)
Buttons styled in brutalist design matching existing controls

subtasks.title: Build interactive crop overlay
subtasks.description: Add a crop mode with a draggable/resizable crop rectangle overlay on the preview image. User can drag corners and edges to define the crop region. Include crop aspect ratio presets (free, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9). Add 'Apply Crop' and 'Cancel' buttons.
completion_criteria: Crop mode toggle button in controls panel
Draggable crop rectangle overlay appears on preview image
Corner handles resize the crop area
Edge handles resize in one axis
Crop area can be repositioned by dragging the center
Crop aspect ratio presets: Free, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9
Dimmed area outside crop region for visual clarity
Apply Crop extracts the selected region via Canvas
Cancel returns to normal editing without changes
Crop dimensions displayed in pixels as user drags
Touch-friendly: works on mobile with touch events

subtasks.title: Integrate crop and rotation into the resize pipeline
subtasks.description: Wire crop and rotation transforms into the existing resize flow. Ensure the processing order is: crop → rotate/flip → resize → format conversion. Update the preview pipeline to show all transforms. Update download to include all applied transforms.
completion_criteria: Processing order: crop → rotate/flip → resize → export
Preview reflects all active transforms in real-time
Download produces correct output with all transforms applied
State tracks crop region, rotation angle, and flip state
New Image button resets all transforms
File size comparison accounts for all transforms

phases.name: Productivity Features
phases.description: Batch processing, clipboard paste, and before/after comparison for power users

subtasks.title: Implement clipboard paste support
subtasks.description: Listen for paste events (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V) globally. Extract image data from clipboard and load it as if it were a file upload. Show a brief toast notification confirming paste. Works on both upload view and editor view (replaces current image).
completion_criteria: Ctrl+V / Cmd+V pastes image from clipboard
Works from screenshot tools and copied images
Brief toast notification: 'Image pasted from clipboard'
Works on upload view (loads image)
Works on editor view (replaces current image)
Non-image clipboard content is silently ignored
Paste hint text shown on upload screen: 'or paste from clipboard (Ctrl+V)'

subtasks.title: Build before/after comparison slider
subtasks.description: Add a comparison mode that shows original vs resized side by side with a draggable slider divider. User can drag the slider left/right to reveal more of either image. Toggle button to enter/exit comparison mode.
completion_criteria: Compare button in editor toggles comparison mode
Original and resized images shown overlaid
Draggable vertical slider divides the two images
Labels: 'Original' on left, 'Resized' on right
Slider works with mouse drag and touch
Smooth performance without jank
Exit comparison returns to normal preview
Styled consistently with brutalist design

subtasks.title: Implement batch processing mode
subtasks.description: Add a batch mode where users can upload multiple images (via multi-select file picker or drag-and-drop). Apply the same resize settings to all images. Show a list of queued images with individual progress. Download all as individual files (triggered sequentially) or as a ZIP using JSZip from CDN.
completion_criteria: Multi-file upload via file picker (multiple attribute)
Multi-file drag-and-drop supported
Batch queue shows list of images with filename, original size, status
Same resize settings applied to all images in batch
Individual progress indicators per image
Download All button triggers sequential downloads
Option to download as ZIP (using JSZip CDN)
Individual remove button per queued image
Error handling: failed images shown with error state, don't block others
Batch mode has its own view/panel, separate from single-image editor

phases.name: Visual Enhancements
phases.description: Filters, dark mode, and custom presets for a complete image tool experience

subtasks.title: Add basic image filters
subtasks.description: Add a filters section with common adjustments: brightness, contrast, saturation, and preset filters (grayscale, sepia, vintage, high-contrast). Use Canvas API getImageData/putImageData for pixel manipulation. Filters apply before resize in the pipeline.
completion_criteria: Brightness slider (-100 to +100, default 0)
Contrast slider (-100 to +100, default 0)
Saturation slider (-100 to +100, default 0)
Preset filter buttons: Grayscale, Sepia, Vintage, High Contrast
Reset Filters button clears all adjustments
Filters preview in real-time (debounced)
Filters applied before resize in the export pipeline
Performance acceptable for images up to 4000x4000px

subtasks.title: Implement dark mode with theme toggle
subtasks.description: Add a dark mode theme with a toggle button in the header. Respect prefers-color-scheme as default. Store preference in localStorage. Create dark variants of all CSS custom properties. Toggle transitions smoothly.
completion_criteria: Dark mode toggle button in header (sun/moon icon)
Defaults to system preference via prefers-color-scheme
User preference saved to localStorage and restored on reload
All colors have dark mode variants via CSS custom properties
Backgrounds, text, borders, shadows all adapt correctly
Checkerboard pattern adapts for dark mode
Transition between themes is smooth (200ms)
WCAG contrast ratios maintained in dark mode

subtasks.title: Add custom user presets with localStorage
subtasks.description: Allow users to save their own dimension presets. Add a 'Save as Preset' button that captures current width/height with a user-provided name. Saved presets appear alongside built-in presets. Presets stored in localStorage. Add delete button for custom presets.
completion_criteria: Save as Preset button opens a name input
Custom preset saved with name, width, height to localStorage
Custom presets displayed in preset grid alongside built-in presets
Custom presets visually distinguished (e.g., different border style)
Delete button (X) on custom presets to remove them
Maximum 10 custom presets with friendly message when limit reached
Presets persist across page reloads
Graceful handling of localStorage being full or unavailable
